title: Are these dice loaded?
prompt:
Someone swears their die is fair. Read their rolls and draw a *histogram*, a bar chart with one bar per face, to check.

The starter's `main` reads numbers until the input runs out. Finish the tally: a roll from 1 to 6 adds 1 to that face's count in the `.bss` array `tally` (face 1 at index 0), and any other value adds 1 to `ignored_r` instead. Then finish the chart: the starter already prints each row's label `f |` and its line break, so print one `#` per roll in between.

`tally` holds ints, 4 bytes each, so entry i sits at `tally + i * 4`: the scaled form `[tally_r, w9, SXTW 2]` does that multiply for you.

The starter's input draws:

```
1 |#
2 |#
3 |###
4 |
5 |#
6 |###
ignored 0
```

## What is checked

- the chart above
- the program exits with status 0
- the same checks on other inputs the checker keeps hidden: no rolls at all, values outside 1 to 6 (0, 7 and negatives), and a die that only ever rolls one face
- the counts are kept in memory (`str`)
starter:
// tally dice rolls from the input and draw one bar per face
define(fp, x29)
define(lr, x30)

define(face_r, w19)
define(count_r, w20)
define(bar_r, w21)
define(tally_r, x22)
define(ignored_r, w23)

define(FACES, 6)

.data
fmt_in:      .string "%d"
fmt_label:   .string "%d |"
fmt_bar:     .string "#"
fmt_newline: .string "\n"
fmt_ignored: .string "ignored %d\n"

.bss
.align 4
tally:      .skip 24                        // FACES ints: the count for each face
roll_in:    .skip 4                         // scanf's landing spot

.text
        .balign 4
        .global main
main:
        stp     fp, lr, [sp, -16]!
        mov     fp, sp

        ldr     tally_r, =tally
        mov     ignored_r, 0
        b       fill_test

next_roll:
        ldr     x9, =roll_in
        ldr     face_r, [x9]

        // TODO: a roll from 1 to FACES adds 1 to its count in tally
        // (face 1 at index 0); anything else adds 1 to ignored_r.

fill_test:
        ldr     x0, =fmt_in
        ldr     x1, =roll_in
        bl      scanf
        cmp     w0, 1                       // 1 value matched; -1 means the input ran out
        b.eq    next_roll

        mov     face_r, 1
        b       face_test
face_loop:
        ldr     x0, =fmt_label
        mov     w1, face_r
        bl      printf

        sub     w9, face_r, 1
        ldr     count_r, [tally_r, w9, SXTW 2]

        // TODO: print fmt_bar count_r times.

        ldr     x0, =fmt_newline
        bl      printf
        add     face_r, face_r, 1
face_test:
        cmp     face_r, FACES
        b.le    face_loop

        ldr     x0, =fmt_ignored
        mov     w1, ignored_r
        bl      printf

        mov     w0, 0
        ldp     fp, lr, [sp], 16
        ret
